text:
Maria: Heads-up — finance just flagged a ~$28k outbound transfer hit for last 24h. looks like traffic from model-artifacts and traces buckets across us-west -> eu-west. invoice attached in thread (billing export id: B-2026-04-09). :eyes:
David: Do we have a query that shows which buckets and prefixes drove the most bytes?
Maria: quick query I ran in Cloud Billing exports: 
```
SELECT sku.description, SUM(cost) as cost, SUM(usage_amount) as gb
FROM `billing.gcp_export`
WHERE invoice_month = '2026-04' AND sku.description LIKE '%Network egress%'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gb DESC LIMIT 20;
```
Maria: top lines point to storage.googleapis.com transfer between regions and inter-region replication on artifacts-prod and traces-ingest buckets.
billing-bot: Automated alert: anomaly detected on billing account redwood-prod — 14.2TB egress (24h) from storage buckets.
Sam: Were those replication rules recently changed? I thought we only replicate model artifacts to eu for inference locality.
Kai: Checking bucket config now — artifacts-prod has an enableCrossRegionReplication policy set in March for disaster recovery. traces-ingest has long retention and logs are forwarded to eu for centralized observability.
Maria: replicating large model checkpoints + uncompressed trace dumps is the combo. also noticed object-level copy ops from a data-migration job that ran yesterday (job id: mig-2026-04-08-ckpt).
David: Can you paste the gsutil ACL/replication config? Might be a lifecycle misconfig that keeps creating new versions.
Sam: Config snippet: 
```
resource": {
  "name": "projects/_/buckets/artifacts-prod",
  "replication": {"enabled": true, "destinations": ["eu-west1"], "overwrite": false}
}
```
Kai: "overwrite": false means every checkpoint version gets copied and never deduped. that's a huge multiplier for size. Also traces-ingest has retention 180d and no compression.
Olivia: I'll open a ticket for finance reconciliation and request hold on further cross-region transfers while we investigate. tagging @david and @sam as owners.
infra-oncall: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Pause replication on artifacts-prod (short-term). 2) Temporarily stop the migration job. 3) Add lifecycle rule to delete non-current object versions older than 7 days. 4) Enable regional logging to eu-only for new traces.
Sam: Agree. Pause replication first. We should also revert the migration job and re-run with hashed diffs so we only transfer changed shards.
Maria: On it — pausing replication now. Running: `gsutil bucket replication pause artifacts-prod` (will update once completed).
Maria: paused — replication suspended at 12:18 UTC. I also asked the migration owner to cancel the remaining copies.
David: Good. For long-term: consider regional model caches + signed URLs for cross-region inference to avoid wholesale bucket replication. Also enforce compression and sharding for trace exports.
Kai: Also propose: move traces-ingest to a regional, lower-cost storage class for old objects and enable gzip on ingestion path. We can also switch to storing raw traces in a compressed Parquet/colocated format to reduce size 5-10x.
Olivia: Finance asked whether this will impact our Reserved Capacity commitments for Dedicated. They want an estimate of ongoing egress if we keep eu inference traffic.
Maria: Quick back-of-envelope: current extraneous replication added ~14TB/day. If kept, monthly would be ~420TB — at current egress rates that's ~100-150k/mo. With replication paused we'll see normal ~2-3TB/mo.
infra-oncall: Action items: 
- sam: reconfigure migration job to use diffs and enable compression (due: 2026-04-10)
- kai: lifecycle policy + compress traces plan (due: 2026-04-11)
- olivia: finance ticket and billing reconciliation (due: 2026-04-10)
- david: design regional cache + signed URL spec to avoid replication (due: 2026-04-17)
- maria: confirm replication resume policy and monitoring alert for cross-region bytes (done: paused)

Sam: I'll also add a billing alert for any single-bucket egress > 500GB/day.
David: Thx everyone. Once we have a short mitigation window we can decide on reserved/commit sizing without this noise. :thumbsup:
Kai: One more small note — check whether artifact builds also push debug symbols to eu; we had a similar leak last year.
Maria: noted and checking. will follow up in the ticket with logs and a CSV of top object prefixes.
Olivia: I'll loop in finance and support to ask for an adjustment/credit while this was an operational replication misconfig.
Maria: closing the immediate alert thread. ping me in thread if you need object lists. :white_check_mark:
